targets.direction: FIRST+sigma72/FIRST-sigma72/NONE; ambiguous excluded only from D
targets.mfe: side MFE BEFORE first 1sigma72 stop; conservative lower; upper sensitivity
targets.signature_scales: fit-only robust IQR on returns; touch fixed; zero scales floor1e-6
targets.q_loss_scales: fit-only median absolute deviation lower MFE, floor1e-6
targets.tau_y: median nonzero outcome distances on fixed seed7 train-only 8192pairs
targets.entry_gap: separate log(entry/reference)/sigma24 and sigma72; never X

stored_arrays.features: N x2[4h,1h] x64 x6 engineered fields float32
stored_arrays.context: N x12 field order defined in btc_pattern_data.CONTEXT
stored_arrays.policy_mfe: N x2[24h,72h] x3[SL.75,1,1.5] x2[long,short] x2[lower,upper]; MFE units base sigma_H, not sigma_H*SL
stored_arrays.signature: N x12: first6 return horizons1/4/12/24/48/72h; next6 first-touch times (+.5,+1,+2,-.5,-1,-2)*sigma72 /72h, no hit=2
stored_arrays.path_reference_indices: N x2 [last known minute close index,entry minute open index] into immutable minutes; includes intervening gap minute
stored_arrays.direction: UP=0 DOWN=1 NONE=2 ambiguous=-1; D-only exclusion
stored_arrays.censor: meta.observed=False => unknown labels remain NaN; no zero imputation
